info.name: Antiphishing Platform API v2.0.0
info.description: Enterprise Banking Antiphishing Platform — Hexagonal Architecture, Selective CQRS, LangChain/Ollama On-Premise AI, n8n SOAR Integration, and Tamper-Evident Audit Trail.

request.description: Answer SOC analyst questions grounded on `docs/{runbooks,compliance,architecture}` and live DB KPIs.
Return exported LangFlow v1 visual sandbox flows (`email_classifier_sandbox`, `url_agent_sandbox`).
Run the multi-tool LangChain URL threat investigation agent.
Return regulatory control mapping (PCI-DSS v4.0, ISO 27001:2022, GDPR) backed by live DB evidence.
Paginated append-only audit trail (`audit_logs`) with SHA-256 chain hashes.
Recompute every SHA-256 hash in `audit_logs` to prove tamper-evident integrity.
Authenticate SOC user with Argon2id + account lockout + optional RFC 6238 TOTP MFA.
Record explicit session logout in the append-only audit trail.
Return current authenticated user profile and RBAC permissions.
Disable TOTP MFA for the current user after optional code or password confirmation.
Verify a live TOTP code and enforce MFA on subsequent logins.
Generate a new RFC 6238 TOTP secret and provisioning URI for authenticator enrollment.
Validate refresh JWT and issue rotated access & refresh tokens.
Return enterprise identity federation readiness (Local Argon2id, SAML 2.0/OIDC, LDAPS).
Compute real-time analytical SOC KPIs, confusion rates, latencies, trends, and SLA compliance.
Return dataset provenance, licensing, schema metadata, and live deduplicated counts.
Trigger idempotent ETL ingestion from OpenPhish or PhishTank (live HTTPS or offline sample).
Paginated list of deduplicated phishing URL samples.
List immutable dataset ingestion runs with SHA-256 integrity hashes.
Inline email inspection invoked by the corporate MTA gateway, n8n SOAR, or SOC analysts.
Parse an RFC 822 `.eml` file upload or JSON `{"raw_eml": "..."}` and run inline detection.
Inspect a standalone URL, SMS smishing link, or decoded QR quishing target.
Employee 'Reportar phishing' button intake; auto-triages incidents when risk_score >= 35.
Paginated list of persisted detection verdicts with multi-criteria filtering.
Return full forensic detail for a single detection verdict.
Set analyst feedback label (`TRUE_POSITIVE` | `FALSE_POSITIVE` | `UNREVIEWED`).
Kubernetes / Docker liveness probe.
Prometheus scrape endpoint exposing operational and detection metrics.
Readiness probe verifying live PostgreSQL connectivity.
Kubernetes / Docker liveness probe.
Prometheus scrape endpoint exposing operational and detection metrics.
Readiness probe verifying live PostgreSQL connectivity.
Paginated list of BLACKLIST and WHITELIST indicators of compromise.
Create or upsert a BLACKLIST or WHITELIST IOC entry with optional TTL and n8n alert.
Fuzzy trigram (`pg_trgm`) IOC search for homographs, typosquats, and partial domains.
Deactivate an IOC entry while preserving forensic audit history.
Paginated list of SOC phishing incidents with status, severity, and SLA breach filters.
Create a manual SOC incident and record immutable creation audit trail.
Sweep open incidents past their SLA deadline, escalate them, and queue n8n alerts.
Return full incident details, immutable timeline events, linked IOCs, and SLA status.
Assign or reassign an incident to a SOC analyst.
Append an immutable investigation note to the incident timeline.
Generate a CISO/SOC executive briefing using the LangChain incident summarizer.
Transition incident state (`OPEN -> TRIAGED -> INVESTIGATING -> CONTAINED -> CLOSED`).
Stream a freshly rendered PDF, DOCX, or XLSX report directly from live PostgreSQL telemetry.
Generate a PDF, DOCX, or XLSX report from JSON criteria (used by SOC UI and n8n daily_report).
List configured recurring report schedules.
Create a recurring DAILY or WEEKLY report schedule.
Execute all due report schedules (or all active schedules when `force_all=true`).
Deactivate and remove a report schedule.
List employee phishing awareness simulation campaigns.
Launch a new phishing awareness simulation campaign.
Record an employee simulation event (`SENT`, `OPENED`, `CLICKED`, `REPORTED`) and recompute KPIs.
Return aggregate human-awareness KPIs across simulation campaigns and employee phishing reports.
Execute unified trigram similarity threat hunting across verdicts, IOCs, and dataset samples.
List all SOC platform users with lockout and MFA posture.
Create a new user enforcing PCI-DSS 8.3 password complexity and Argon2id hashing.
Return the role-to-permissions RBAC matrix.
Update user role, active status, unlock account, or rotate password.
